name: Kinkon Falls and the Fouta Djallon
subtitle: Kinkon Falls are on the Kokoulo River near Pita in the Fouta Djallon highlands and are listed at 80 metres.

facts.label: Hydropower plant
facts.value: 3.4 MW plant in Pita District upstream of the falls on the Kokoulo River

facts.label: Towns served
facts.value: Pita, Labe, Dalaba, Timbi-Matina, Mamou and Boulizel

facts.label: Fouta Djallon highlands
facts.value: Central area of 60,000 km2, with foothills over more than 300,000 km2 reaching Guinea-Bissau, Mali, Senegal and Sierra Leone

facts.label: Water tower
facts.value: Called the Water Tower of West Africa; birthplace of 7 of the region's largest rivers

facts.label: Pressure
facts.value: Brief describes degradation of the highlands' resources and ecosystems from climate change and local practices

parts.text: Kinkon Falls are on the Kokoulo River near Pita in the Fouta Djallon highlands and are listed at 80 metres. A 3.4 MW hydropower plant stands upstream of the falls and serves six towns. The Fouta Djallon is known as the water tower of West Africa and is reported to be degrading.
